vv18:1.1: PĪṬHAVAGGO PAṬHAMO II CITTALATAVĀGGA Api Sakko va devindo ramme Cittalatāvane samantā anupariyāsi nārīgaṇapurakkhatā obhāsentī disā sabbā osadhī viya tārakā. || ||
vv18:2.1: Kena t' etādiso vaṇṇo kena te idha-m-ijjhati uppajjanti ca te bhogā ye keci manaso piyā. || ||
vv18:3.1: Pucchāmi taṃ devi mahānubhāve manussabhūtā kim akāsi puññaṃ kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvā vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī ti. || ||
vv18:4.1: Sā devatā attamanā Moggallānena pucchitā pañhaṃ puṭṭhā viyākāsi yassa kammass' idaṃ phalaṃ: || ||
vv18:5.1: Ahaṃ manussesu manussabhūtā dāsī ahosiṃ parapessiyā kule.
vv18:6.1: upāsikā cakkhumato Gotamassa yasassino. || || Tassā me nikkamo āsi sāsane tassa tādino:
vv18:7.1: kāmaṃ bhijjatu 'yaṃ kāyo n' eva atth' ettha santhanaṃ. || || Sikkhāpadānaṃ pañcannaṃ maggo sovatthiko sivo
vv18:8.1: akaṇṭako agahaṇo uju sabbhi pavedito. || || Nikkamassa phalaṃ passa yath' idaṃ pāpuṇ' itthikā
vv18:9.1: āmantanikā rañño 'mhi Sakkassa vasavattino. || || Saṭṭhituriyasahassāni paṭibodhaṃ karonti me
vv18:10.1: Ālambo Gaggaro Bhīmo Sādhuvādī ca Saṃsayo, || || Pokkharo ca Suphasso ca Vīṇāmokkhā ca nāriyo
vv18:11.1: Nandā c' eva Sunandā ca Soṇadinnā Sucimhitā || || Alambusā Missakesī ca Puṇḍarīkāti {dāruṇī}
vv18:12.1: Eṇiphassā Suphassā ca Subhaddā Muduvādinī. || || Etā c' aññā ca seyyāse accharānaṃ pabodhikā
vv18:13.1: tā maṃ kālen' upāgantvā abhibhāsanti devatā: || || Handa naccāma gāyāma handa taṃ ramayāmase
vv18:14.1: na-y-idaṃ akatapuññānaṃ katapuññānam ev' idaṃ. || || Asokaṃ Nandanaṃ rammaṃ Tidasānaṃ mahāvanaṃ
vv18:15.1: sukhaṃ akatapuññānaṃ idha natthi parattha ca sukhañ ca katapuññānaṃ idha c' eva parattha ca. || ||
vv18:16.1: Tesaṃ sahavyakāmanaṃkattabbaṃ kusalaṃ bahuṃ katapuññā hi modanti sagge bhogasamaṅgino ti. || ||
